problem.title: Find the Largest Almost Missing Integer

approaches.title: Case-based frequency and endpoint analysis
approaches.summary: Handles k == 1 by counting frequencies, k == n by taking the maximum, and intermediate k by checking whether the first or last values are unique to their respective windows. Later revisions streamline iteration and find the largest unique value directly from the frequency bucket.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduced the case-based solution using a frequency bucket for k == 1, a global maximum for k == n, and endpoint uniqueness checks otherwise.

revisions.commitComment: simplified code with better use of iterators
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3471: simplified code with better use of iterators
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Refactored the same strategy with iterator-based maximum and fold operations, while simplifying ownership and early-return handling.

revisions.commitComment: early escape with no max tracking for case 1
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3471: early escape with no max tracking for case 1
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Cached the array length and searched the frequency bucket in reverse to find the largest unique value without tracking a maximum over the input.
